name: productweaver
description: Product management skills for your AI assistant, from Product Weaver. pw-discovery turns customer interview transcripts into an Outcome-Driven Innovation knowledge base, with every quote checked against its transcript. pw-start gets you going: it plans your first interviews, or turns the ones you have into a discovery map, and says what to do next.

interface.shortDescription: Turn customer interviews into an ODI knowledge base
defaultPrompt: Help me get started with Product Weaver
Turn the interviews in this folder into a discovery map
